publisher: Devon County Council / Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record
evidence_slice: Devon County Council's public Environment/Devon Local Nature Recovery Strategy 'Other Useful Layers' service exposes layer 669 'Listed buildings' as an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer maintained by the Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record, with fields including ListEntry, Name, Grade, NGR, CaptureScale and NHLE_URL. The layer description states that it covers Devon, Torbay and Dartmoor HER administrative areas and warns that central Exeter records are out of date. A distinct one-record GeoJSON query for ListEntry 1103958 was attempted with returnGeometry=true, but the response was not retrievable through the available web channel, so no feature payload or polygon coordinates were accepted.

field_evidence.footprint: Layer 669 metadata declares esriGeometryPolygon and a Shape field, but the selected ListEntry 1103958 query payload was not retrievable, so no polygon coordinates were accepted.
field_evidence.type_use: Layer 669 metadata declares record-bound Name and Grade fields alongside ListEntry, but the selected record payload was not retrievable, so no record value was accepted.
field_evidence.coverage: Layer metadata states Devon/Torbay/Dartmoor HER coverage and warns that central Exeter records are out of date.
